import copy
before = current_frame
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':26,'col':14}])
after = current_frame
# diff tile colors at all node positions
def tiles(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']<=16 and n['color'] not in ('N','B','G','c'):
            bs=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bs]; cs=[p[1] for p in bs]
            d[(min(rs),min(cs))]=n['color']
    return d
tb,ta = tiles(before), tiles(after)
print("changed cells:")
for k in sorted(set(tb)|set(ta)):
    if tb.get(k)!=ta.get(k):
        print(f"  ({k[0]},{k[1]}): {tb.get(k)} -> {ta.get(k)}")
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','reward') if k in last_action_result})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
